<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33% intensity relative to the base peak, which is characteristic of a single chlorine atom (Cl‑35/Cl‑37 ratio ~3:1). There is also a clear M+1 peak at ~12% intensity, consistent with the natural 13C abundance and indicating the presence of carbon. No 1:1 M+2 pattern (bromine) or ~4% M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
